evidence.name: worker.env
evidence.text:
# worker.env, deployed to the background worker host
# file mode 0600, owner svc-worker, group svc-worker
DATABASE_URL=postgres://worker@db.internal:5432/cookbook
QUEUE_URL=amqp://worker@mq.internal:5672/jobs

I-02.reason: worker.env states a file mode of 0600 for the worker account; it says nothing of encryption at rest or of the protection on the read-configuration flow the draft calls open.

R-03.reason: worker.env states who may read the file, not that a read is logged or attributed, which is what the draft calls missing.

control_reasons.I-02: worker.env states file mode 0600 with owner and group svc-worker, so only the worker account reads the configuration the draft says other readers can reach.
